aboutText: Nav Cabinetry & Woodworks has been serving Campbellfield since 2008, specialising in bespoke cabinetry for homes and businesses. Our team designs and builds kitchen cabinets, bathroom vanities, and custom joinery using traditional techniques and modern materials. We focus on attention to detail and durable construction to create functional, beautiful pieces that enhance your space.
servicesText: From design to installation, Nav Cabinetry offers comprehensive services for kitchens, bathrooms, and living areas. We create custom solutions that fit your style and practical requirements, using high-quality timber and finishes.

services.title: Kitchen Cabinets
services.desc: Design and install custom kitchen cabinets that maximise storage and elevate your Campbellfield kitchen's look.

services.title: Bathroom Vanities
services.desc: Craft stylish, durable vanities tailored to your bathroom's layout and your personal taste.

services.title: Custom Joinery
services.desc: Build bespoke joinery pieces like shelves, desks, and entertainment units for seamless home integration.

services.title: Wardrobes & Storage
services.desc: Create organised wardrobe and storage solutions that fit perfectly into your bedroom or living space.

services.title: Furniture Making
services.desc: Produce custom furniture items such as tables, chairs, and cabinets with expert woodworking.

services.title: Repairs & Renovations
services.desc: Restore or update existing cabinetry to refresh your home without a full replacement.
